enigmaticaddons_idle_frost_skip.conversion: MixinSquared @TargetHandler + MixinExtras @WrapOperation (priority 1500) on the canFreeze() call inside Enigmatic Addons' tickMix handler (merged into LivingEntity.tick): while the entity has no frozen ticks, its class does not override canFreeze, the merged canFreeze bodies of LivingEntity and Entity hold only Minecraft's calls and handlers of the reviewed read-only mixins (Curios' MixinLivingEntity, Enigmatic Addons' MixinLivingEntity, Blast from the Past's EntityMixin; the group plugin's look through two empty mixins of priority 999999, and no mixin of another mod with priority 999999 or more on those classes) and curios_presence's quiet() says a curio walk would only read, the call is left out and true is passed on (the condition is false either way). MixinExtras @WrapOperation on the getEnchantmentLevel call of AddonEventHandler.onTick: while the entity has no frozen ticks the lookup is left out and 0 passed on (both writes would set 0 on a 0, which SynchedEntityData ignores). Runtime flag enigmaticaddonsIdleFrostSkip, shadow enigmaticaddonsIdleFrostSkip.shadow. Helpers bons.furious.patch.enigmaticaddons_coo49.FrostSkip, EaPlugin.
